title: AT&T consumer wireless service policy bundle: data usage, billing, cancellation, changes and equipment returns
base_rule: Apply the AT&T Consumer Service Agreement provisions that are relevant to the customer's wireless service. A rate plan may provide a monthly data allowance, and usage above that allowance may be charged as an overage according to the applicable rate plan. Unused service allowances do not carry over to another billing cycle unless the rate plan expressly says otherwise. Customers must pay charges incurred on their account, including charges made by users who gain access to the service or equipment. Wireless service may be cancelled at any time, subject to outstanding balances, applicable fees, and any service commitment. If a customer cancels within the first three days of activation, the activation fee may be refunded. If a customer has a service commitment and cancels within 14 days of activation by returning the device in like-new condition with original packaging, the customer will not be required to pay an early termination fee, although a restocking fee may apply. Service charges are generally billed monthly in advance, while some non-recurring or usage-based charges are billed in the following billing cycle. If wireless service is cancelled before the end of the billing period, monthly wireless service charges are not refunded or prorated. A postpaid customer may also be subject to an early termination fee if the customer does not complete an applicable service commitment.

published_policy.text: Scoped summary of the AT&T Consumer Service Agreement's wireless-service provisions: a rate plan may include a monthly data allowance, with overage usage charged according to the plan; unused allowances generally do not carry over; customers are responsible for charges incurred through their account; wireless service may be cancelled at any time subject to balances, fees, commitments, and any applicable device-return conditions; cancellation within three days of activation may qualify for an activation-fee refund; a customer with a service commitment may avoid an early termination fee by cancelling within 14 days and returning the device in like-new condition with original packaging, although a restocking fee may apply; monthly service charges are billed in advance and some usage charges later; monthly wireless service charges are not refunded or prorated when service is cancelled before the end of the billing period. This is a scoped paraphrase, not the complete official terms.
published_policy.classification_note: Draft classification based on the cited official AT&T Consumer Service Agreement and its linked wireless-service sections. The text is limited to selected consumer wireless provisions and should be reviewed against the exact customer rate plan and applicable state law.

adaptation_note: The provider is real and the policy is based on the official AT&T Consumer Service Agreement. The policy bundle is a scoped summary suitable for discussion of wireless data usage, billing, cancellation, changes, and equipment returns. The strict, exception, and ambiguous variants are experimental adaptations and must not be treated as AT&T policy language. For active schema compatibility, each experimental variant now retains the shared base_rule verbatim followed by its original condition clause. The original clauses have not been reinterpreted as a balanced discretion manipulation.
